name: Jeroboam
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Jehoash slept with his fathers and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Jeroboam the son of Joash, Jeroboam II, began to reign over Israel and reigned forty-one years, doing evil and not departing from the sins of the first Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: The Most High saved them by the hand of Jeroboam, who recovered Damascus and Hamath, and when he slept with his fathers Zechariah his son reigned in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Zachariah the son of Jeroboam over the northern kingdom in Samaria, six months, and he did what we do best, which is evil.
Zachariah son of Jeroboam reigns over Israel only six months and does that which is evil, not departing from the sins of Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: The record was reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel, keeping the account by name.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 5: The Tribes East of Jordan and Their Captivity

points: The word of the Lord came unto Hosea the son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

note.label: Hosea 1: A Wife of Whoredoms and the Sand of the Sea

points: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

note.label: Amos 1: For Three Transgressions and For Four

points: A plumb line is used for measuring. Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more; I'mma cut them off. The high places of Isaac shall be desolate: that's the southern kingdom. And the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste: northern kingdom. And I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

points: The high places of Isaac shall be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel laid waste, and he will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

note.label: Amos 7: The Plumb Line and the Prophet's Job

points: Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam that Amos had conspired against him and that the land could not bear his words.

note.label: Amos 7: The Plumb Line and the Prophet's Job
